verdict.rationale: Riveter scrapes and crawls websites, so honoring robots.txt and target-site rate limits is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never mentions robots.txt compliance or per-site throttling. The SDK's handling of 429 retries concerns the client calling Riveter's own API, not politeness toward the sites being crawled, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
